def dedup(items):
    out = []
    seen_hashable = set()
    seen_unhashable = []
    for it in items:
        try:
            hash(it)
            if it not in seen_hashable:
                seen_hashable.add(it)
                out.append(it)
        except TypeError:
            # unhashable element: fall back to linear equality comparison
            if it not in seen_unhashable:
                seen_unhashable.append(it)
                out.append(it)
    return out
